Configure a demo-tenant run, then Save config · v2026-10-02.1

Local only · owner-only file

Build a demo config

Pick a scenario (or describe your own), choose content and enter the five demo users - then Save config straight into your DemoIQ workspace (~/.copilot/DemoIQ-Output-Scout/configs): a plain file only you can read, never in the repository, so the demo-user passwords stay on this machine. The App ID comes from your deployment, and the tenant administrator signs in when a run starts - no admin password is stored.

DemoIQ needs an EXISTING Microsoft 365 demo tenant - it never creates one. Nothing on this page provisions a tenant, users, or licenses: the admin and the five demo users you enter below must already exist in a demo tenant you control (e.g. one provisioned through CDX). No demo tenant yet? Get one first, then come back here.

App registration

App ID from your deployment

Pre-filled by the agent from your deployment's receipts (deploy.py status) before this page opened - nothing to type here. The App ID must be this deployment's DemoIQ app, so it is read-only; if it is empty, ask the agent in chat to re-open the Config Builder.

1

Admin sign-in

The Global Admin of the EXISTING demo tenant this run seeds (DemoIQ does not create tenants or accounts). No password here: this administrator signs in with a device code each time a run starts.

2

Demo users

Enter the five demo users from your demo tenant - UPN and password for each. There are no preset accounts: every tenant provisions different demo users, so type the UPNs that actually exist in this tenant. The seeder signs in as exactly what you enter, and passwords let it post AS each user.

3

Scenario

Brands the demo content, fallback file names, and the AoP runbook. A custom scenario's own "Company:" line still wins over this field.

Customize generated file names

Leave blank to keep the scenario's defaults. Filling any renames the generated files (extensions added automatically).

or

Type the scenario to bake it into the config, or leave it blank and the agent will ask you to describe it in chat when you build the run.

4

Content types

Run-time heads-up: the more content you seed, the longer the run takes - every selected type is authored at run time and then seeded. Pick only what the demo needs; counts are trimmable under "Counts & advanced options" below.

Copilot Code and Copilot Autopilot are preview surfaces: DemoIQ seeds for them and writes their runbook sections, but cannot check that the demo tenant has them enabled - confirm before the session.

Meeting audio & RTMP streaming

Optional

Only needed if you'll play meeting audio live during the demo. The seeder generates an MP3 per meeting (when the meetings content type and a Speech resource ID are set), and you stream it into a Teams meeting via RTMP-In. Leave blank to skip.

How to set up RTMP-In in Teams
  1. Generate the audio first. Enable the meetings content type (Content types above) and set a Speech resource ID (App registration) - the seeder then produces an MP3 per meeting.
  2. Install FFmpeg if you don't have it: Windows winget install --id Gyan.FFmpeg -e, macOS brew install ffmpeg, Linux your distribution's ffmpeg package.
  3. Enable RTMP-In on your Teams demo meeting: open the meeting's Meeting options and turn Allow RTMP-In on.
  4. Reveal the URL & key. Join/start the meeting, then More (...) → Broadcast / RTMP-In to show the ingestion URL and stream key.
  5. Paste them above into Stream URL and Stream key, then Save config.
  6. Run the streamer (bundled with this skill; run from the repository root, or ask GitHub Copilot to stream it):
    pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .github/skills/demoiq-seed/scripts/stream_rtmp.ps1 -Mp3 "<path to meeting_transcript_*.mp3>" -StreamUrl "<ingest URL>" -StreamKey "<stream key>"
    Press Q or Ctrl+C to stop. The audio plays into the meeting as a participant.

Exact Teams labels can vary by client version. The Stream URL/key saved here are offered as defaults at run time - values read from the live meeting always win (keys rotate per meeting).

Counts & advanced options

No count-based content selected - enable content types above to configure their counts.

Each count appears only when its content type is enabled above. wordDocs / pptDecks / excelWorkbooks set how many separate FILES of that type get seeded (default 1, max 5); the other Word/PPT/Excel counts size the inside of each file. Every count is a whole number of at least 1 (blank = the default shown). Higher counts lengthen the run - see the run-time note under Content types.

Save

Saves DemoIQ_config.json straight into your DemoIQ configs library (~/.copilot/DemoIQ-Output-Scout/configs) as a plain file only you can read - never into the repository. It holds the full configuration, so loading restores everything and it can drive a run on its own via --from-config.

Visible fields are kept minimal - the App ID is pre-filled and advanced knobs live behind disclosures so the form stays calm.
